findings.summary: Audit repair changes the accepted GS2-07.2 subject and scheduling-key identity, so event and audit inputs do not converge to the same queued subject.
evidence: eng/github-substrate-v2-units.json:831 requires supported event and audit inputs to converge to the same queued subject and newest relevant revision.

src/FS.GG.Coordination.Qualification.Contracts/GitHubNarrowReconciliationQualification.fs:80-81,145 compiles the local event subject as kind:id and hashes repository plus that subject, while src/FS.GG.Coordination.Qualification.Contracts/GitHubAuditRepairQualification.fs:74-76,180 prefixes the repository into the subject and then hashes the repository a second time.

Built-artifact comparison at d3d92de69b4f2c019964fa477a5a4bf54ce5cec9 produced narrow subject issue:304/key e6114ed3b46399c49a15a0ebbf59ff347ab1b4b21c9675b19fe7dbedfc6d3dd2 and audit subject FS-GG/FS.GG.Coordination|issue:304/key 332958f079b48a3cb9e4cd1d58fe5397912f7e9001d8179868ae1ed6a2869fb2; both equality checks were false.

eng/validate-github-audit-repair.fsx:73 and tests/FS.GG.Coordination.UnitTests/GitHubAuditRepairTests.fs:32-40 call only the audit-repair compiler, so the advertised convergence controls stay green without comparing the accepted narrow-reconciliation route they claim to converge with.
resolution_evidence: Pending implementation repair and exact-head confirmation round 1.

findings.summary: The audit compiler accepts unknown subject kinds, so the required unknown-input refusal and supported-event convergence boundary are absent.
evidence: eng/github-substrate-v2-units.json:831 requires unknown inputs to remain explicit refusals and limits convergence to supported event and audit inputs inherited from GS2-07.2.

src/FS.GG.Coordination.Qualification.Contracts/GitHubAuditRepairQualification.fs:123-139 validates only token shape and checks Route against the caller-supplied SubjectKind; it never compares SubjectKind with GS2-07.2's supportedEventKinds inventory.

Built-artifact execution at d3d92de69b4f2c019964fa477a5a4bf54ce5cec9 replaced the issue observation with SubjectKind=mystery and Route=reconcile/mystery, retained a complete four-class/page baseline with empty event history, and returned Ok with four queue entries.

tests/FS.GG.Coordination.UnitTests/GitHubAuditRepairTests.fs:58-65 and eng/validate-github-audit-repair.fsx:94,98 cover stale source revision and unknown classification but contain no unknown-subject-kind adversary, so the Q3 validator remains green on this acceptance escape.
resolution_evidence: Pending implementation repair and exact-head confirmation round 1.
